issue.title: [T2 Profile]: Some scripts are failing for multi-asic chassis-packet system due to wrong router_mac

failure.body:
**Description**

test_lldp, test_interfaces, test_arpall are failing for multi-asic chassis-packet system due to wrong router_mac. The test is picking the mac address of eth0 instead of picking the mac-address of the respective asic.

Proposing this change for T2 profile

    if tbinfo["topo"]["type"] == "t2":
        config_facts = duthost.asic_instance(enum_asic_index).config_facts(host=duthost.hostname, source="running")['ansible_facts']
        router_mac = config_facts['DEVICE_METADATA']['localhost']['mac'].lower()
    else:
        router_mac = duthost.facts['router_mac']
